architecture.mechanism: Transdisciplinary synthesis replacing vertical hyperspecialization to integrate closed-system procedural routines into a unified diagnostic framework.
architecture.intervention: Apply transdisciplinary synthesis by integrating valvetrain acoustics, tribology, and oil pump fluid dynamics diagnostics to identify the root cause of ticking noise when low oil level indicators fail to activate and no external leaks are present, addressing internal oil starvation pathways missed by specialized single-domain checks.
architecture.expected_effect: Identification and correction of internal oil gallery blockage or hydraulic lash adjuster bleed-down causing valvetrain ticking despite normal indicated oil level and absence of external leaks.
architecture.falsification_test: Perform an engine oil pressure test at the cylinder head gallery using a mechanical gauge during cold start; if measured pressure exceeds the hydraulic lash adjuster minimum threshold and ticking persists, the internal oil starvation mechanism is falsified.
